newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain buying pesetas versus marks - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain buying pesetas versus marks - dealers.

text.p: The Bank of Spain was buying pesetas versus the mark at around 84.75, dealers said on Tuesday.

"The peseta slid with the lira to 84.75 level and later the market was trying to break this level. But it remains there because the Bank of Spain is buying very aggressively," a dealer in Madrid said.
The Bank of Spain, did not, as is its practice, comment.
At 1605 GMT the peseta was trading at 84.74/75 to the mark versus an opening level of 84.54/59. -- Madrid newsroom +341 585 2160
